Growth.brand_tagline: Turn code changes into lasting learning
Growth.local_first: Code stays local · Sync only what you choose
Growth.intro_today: Start with a short card or a due review.
Growth.intro_learning: Analyze changes, choose an opportunity, and save your answers and notes.
Growth.learning_setup: Connect a local project first, then learn from real code changes.
Growth.intro_topics: Discuss ideas, confirm topics, and revisit notes and evidence.
Growth.intro_projects: Connect a local repository, track a feature, and capture versioned changes.
Growth.today_status: {projects} connected projects and {tasks} learning cards recorded.
Growth.settings_intro: Configure only the model connections and local privacy boundary needed for growth. Review cloud uploads on the Today, Learning, Topics, or Projects page.
Growth.settings_models_hint: Choose models for learning opportunities, feedback, and chat. Source files still require approval before sending.
Growth.settings_no_provider: No model is configured. Add a connection to start analysis.
Growth.settings_privacy_hint: Model and cloud transfers follow project policy and a send preview.
Growth.settings_load_failed: Could not load local settings. Try again.
Growth.settings_save_failed: Could not save settings. Try again.
Growth.title: Developer Growth
Growth.intro: Connect a local Git repository, capture versioned changes, and choose what may be sent to a configured model.
Growth.load_failed: Could not load local growth records.
Growth.action_failed: The operation failed. Check the project, Git path and base reference.
Growth.sync_description: Preview the selected project's requests, including analyses, answers and notes. Approval queues and uploads them with their original IDs. Without a preview, sync only uploads queued operations and downloads cloud records. The access token stays on this page.
Growth.sync_preview_failed: Preview failed; check local records and privacy restrictions
Growth.sync_approve: I reviewed the complete content and approve publishing this project
Growth.sync_refresh_history: Download complete revision history again to fill missing base text
Growth.sync_failed: Cloud sync failed. Local records and pending operations are preserved. Check the URL, token and network, then retry.
Growth.sync_outbox_status: Queued {queued}, uploaded {uploaded}, pulled {pulled} changes; pending {pending}, conflicts {conflict}, deleted drafts for recovery {deleted}. Only approved local records enter the upload count.
Growth.export_hint: Create a consistent cloud snapshot for the synced account, then save JSON and Markdown locally. ReMe is not needed for export.
Growth.export_failed: Export failed. Check the cloud URL, token and synced account.
Growth.review_hint: Load due cards for the synced account. Write your answer first, then record the hint level and self-rating. After a hint, Good and Easy are unavailable.
Growth.review_connect_first: Connect and sync a cloud account first.
Growth.review_saved: Review answer saved and the next due time updated.
Growth.review_load_failed: Could not load due reviews. Check the cloud connection.
Growth.review_submit_failed: Review save failed. Your answer remains in the editor; retry when ready.
Growth.chat_hint: Send a message, review the full model request, then approve it. Topic suggestions require a separate decision. Retry an upload with the same request ID after a failure.
Growth.chat_connect_first: Connect and sync a cloud account first.
Growth.chat_link_project: Link the new chat to the selected project (requires publication and model permission)
Growth.chat_approve: I reviewed the full content and approve sending it to this model
Growth.chat_reset: Discard this request and preview again
Growth.chat_queued: The reply is saved in the local queue; connect and sync to upload it.
Growth.topics_hint: Topic operations check cloud revisions. Merging keeps the old ID as an alias and preserves note text. Choose each note and card association when splitting.
Growth.topics_note_text: Write a note for this topic
Growth.topics_merge_hint: The selected topic is the source. Its notes and cards move to the target; the old ID remains an alias. Check both revisions first.
Growth.topics_merge_approve: I checked the source and target and approve the merge
Growth.topics_split_hint: Name two child topics and choose the association for each note and card. Original text and parent history remain.
Growth.topics_saved: Saved. Review the current topic and revision.
Growth.topics_retry_hint: Reload the current revision and review before retrying.
Growth.event_inbox_hint: Cloud events carry only the project, feature and expected Git HEAD. This device checks its target, local binding and HEAD before capture. Model analysis still requires a payload preview and approval.
Growth.event_inbox_empty: No synced development events for this device.
Growth.event_inbox_failed: Could not read cached development events.
Growth.event_pending_target: This event has not been assigned to this device yet.
Growth.event_bind_first: Bind this project to a local repository below first.
Growth.event_untracked_failed: Could not read untracked files for this repository.
Growth.event_capture_failed: Event capture failed. Check the device, approved project, feature and current Git HEAD.
Growth.event_capture_ready: Source snapshot captured. Review the model payload below and approve one linked analysis.
Growth.event_capture_reused: Opened this event's existing snapshot without capturing it again.
Growth.event_analysis_context: This snapshot came from a development event. Review the model payload before starting its linked analysis. Retries reuse that analysis.
Growth.note_workspace_hint: Read cached notes and write revisions offline. Use Connect and sync above to upload. For conflicts, read all three originals and write the merged result yourself.
Growth.note_workspace_empty: No synced notes yet. Connect to the cloud to load them.
Growth.note_base_missing: This device has not cached the base text. Select the full history refresh above and sync.
Growth.note_recovery_text: Local recovery copy of a deleted note
Growth.note_deleted_hint: Cloud deletion has propagated. Old text and recovery drafts remain on this device and will not be restored automatically.
Growth.note_merge_text: Write the complete merged text yourself
Growth.note_revision_text: Write the complete revised text yourself
Growth.note_delete_approve: I confirm this note should be deleted on my other devices
Growth.note_queued: Saved to the local queue. Connect to upload it.
Growth.note_queue_failed: Could not save. Sync the latest revision, check cloud permission and pending operations.
Growth.excerpt_title: Source excerpts for reading across devices
Growth.excerpt_hint: Source stays on this device by default. Preview exact lines, then separately approve cloud sync. Model approval is independent.
Growth.excerpt_approve: I reviewed this source excerpt and approve cloud sync
Growth.excerpt_preview_failed: Could not preview. Check line numbers, snapshot and sensitive content.
Growth.excerpt_queue_failed: Could not queue. Sync metadata first and check project permission and source version.
Growth.excerpt_queued: Excerpt approval saved. Use Sync now to upload.
Growth.excerpt_unbound: This device has no repository binding. You can read approved excerpts; live navigation requires binding and version verification.
Growth.source_binding_done: Repository bound to the same project
Growth.source_binding_failed: Could not bind repository; check the Git path
Growth.source_verify_failed: Could not verify the local source version
Growth.source_matched: Version matches; locate at local path
Growth.source_version_mismatch: Version differs; original excerpt remains available
Growth.source_missing: Local file missing; original excerpt remains available
Growth.journey_open: View learning timeline and next question
Growth.journey_failed: Could not load the learning timeline
Growth.task_workspace_hint: Save drafts, submit answers and change progress for synced cards offline. Operations remain on this device and upload in order when connected.
Growth.task_conflict_preserved: The conflicting draft or recovery copy is preserved. Review both originals, then edit and save a new draft. The old conflict remains below.
Growth.task_rebase_draft: Save a new draft from the current cloud revision
Growth.task_answer_text: Write a draft or complete answer yourself
Growth.task_feedback_approve: I reviewed the answer and source excerpt and approve sending them to this model
Growth.task_queued: Saved to the local queue. Connect to upload it.
Growth.task_queue_failed: Could not save. Sync the latest card and check cloud permission.
Growth.model_allowed: Allow approved content to be sent to the selected model
Growth.cloud_permission_hint: Model sending and cloud sync are independent. Preview and approve above to enable cloud sync. Disabling it retains pending publication operations and pauses their upload.
Growth.cloud_publish_blocked: The new record remains local but was not queued for cloud upload
Growth.repository_path_hint: Absolute path to a local Git repository
Growth.base_ref_hint: For example, main or a fixed commit SHA
Growth.capture_description: Read the selected repository and save a versioned local snapshot. Source code stays on this device.
Growth.untracked_failed: Could not list untracked Git files.
Growth.head: Git HEAD
Growth.analysis_description: Run a local code diagnostic or review the exact source scope before a model request.
Growth.code_index_description: Enter Class.method symbols in call order. The index reads local source matching this snapshot; unresolved calls are marked unknown.
Growth.code_index_failed: Could not index this call path. Check the symbols and snapshot; capture again if source changed.
Growth.module_description: Check the call path and source locations above, then name and save a module candidate. Locking requires a separate action.
Growth.module_cloud_required: Connect and sync Growth Cloud before saving or locking a module.
Growth.module_reindex: Reindex selected module for this snapshot
Growth.module_reindexed: Module updated for this snapshot; existing cards retain their index revision.
Growth.module_reindex_failed: Could not reindex the module. Sync the new snapshot first, or retry the same operation.
Growth.module_adjustment_proposed: Module members changed. The previous boundary is retained until you confirm.
Growth.module_adjustment_failed: Could not confirm the change. Retry the same operation.
Growth.module_mapped: Module candidate saved to Growth Cloud.
Growth.module_list_failed: Could not load cloud modules. Check the synced account and project.
Growth.module_map_failed: Could not save the module. Retry the same operation.
Growth.module_lock_failed: Could not lock the module. Retry the same operation.
Growth.analysis_reused: Reused the analysis for the same request.
Growth.analysis_failed: Analysis failed. The analysis ID and failure record remain available for retry.
Growth.analysis_poll_failed: Could not read analysis progress. Refresh to see saved records.
Growth.analysis_start_failed: Could not start analysis. Check the snapshot and repository binding.
Growth.analysis_needs_recapture: Source changed. Capture a new snapshot.
Growth.model_description: Select a configured provider and source files. Review the exact redacted request before sending it.
Growth.model_sources_failed: Could not read the snapshot sources.
Growth.model_preview_failed: Could not prepare the model request. Check the provider configuration and selected files.
Growth.no_provider: Configure a model provider in Settings first.
Growth.model_exact_payload: Approved redacted content (may be clipped to fit the model context)
Growth.approve_model_send: I reviewed this content and approve sending it to the selected provider.
Growth.topic_reuse_load_failed: Existing topics could not be loaded. Connect and sync again.
Growth.hint_description: Local thinking cues; no source is sent. Answers record the hint level viewed.
Growth.note_prompt_fact: Which code fact from this change is worth remembering?
Growth.note_prompt_next: What will you check first when you see similar code again?
Growth.note_label: Write down what you want to remember
Growth.task_load_failed: Could not load the card history.
Growth.feedback_payload: Approved answer and redacted source context
Growth.feedback_done: Feedback saved. The original answer is preserved.
Growth.feedback_failed: Feedback failed. The original answer is preserved and can be retried.
Growth.feedback_preview_failed: Could not prepare the feedback request.
Growth.feedback_start_failed: Could not start feedback. Review the request again.

Error.boundary_body: This view could not load. Other growth records are safe.
Error.boundary_exhausted: Retry limit reached. Reload the page or copy the error and report it.

Settings_page.provider_api_key_hint: Paste the key directly. It is saved only to {location}; config stores only a reference name, never the key.
Settings_page.provider_api_key_keep_ph: Leave blank to keep the current key
Settings_page.provider_api_key_location_global: the global config dir's .env file (0600; on Windows protected by the %APPDATA% user ACL)
Settings_page.provider_api_key_location_repo: the local <repo>/.ahadiff/.env file (gitignored, file permissions restricted on a best-effort basis)
Settings_page.provider_capabilities_failed: Model capabilities could not be checked. Your settings have been kept; explicit thinking choices need a successful check.
Settings_page.provider_capabilities_loading: Checking model limits and thinking settings…
Settings_page.provider_error_auth_required: Authentication is required to perform this action.
Settings_page.provider_error_bad_field: Invalid field value, invalid alias, or alias conflict.
Settings_page.provider_error_feature_unavailable: This feature is not supported in the current environment.
Settings_page.provider_error_lock_conflict: Configuration is locked by another process. Please try again.
Settings_page.provider_error_loopback_denied: Security policy denied connection to loopback address.
Settings_page.provider_error_not_found: The requested resource was not found.
Settings_page.provider_error_rate_limited: Too many requests. You have been rate limited.
Settings_page.provider_error_validation_error: Input validation failed. Please check the fields and try again.
Settings_page.provider_hint_deepseek: Tip: For DeepSeek BYOK, use 'openai_compat' so structured output uses JSON object mode; official v4 reasoning appears when supported.
Settings_page.provider_limits_warning_default_fallback: Some model limits are unknown, so the app will use safe runtime caps.
Settings_page.provider_limits_warning_local_runtime: This local runtime decides limits at load time; run a connection test for current values.
Settings_page.provider_limits_warning_low_confidence: This registry row has low confidence; verify before relying on the limit.
Settings_page.provider_limits_warning_max_output_clamp: The saved output override was clamped to the known model limit.
Settings_page.provider_limits_warning_registry_warning: The registry reported an additional caution for this model.
Settings_page.provider_limits_warning_route_specific: This route can use provider-specific limits, so treat recommendations as estimates.
Settings_page.provider_limits_warning_unknown: Model limits could not be verified.
Settings_page.provider_limits_warning_unverified_overr: The saved output override could not be verified against a hard model limit.
Settings_page.provider_max_output_hint: Leave blank to use the model default limit.
Settings_page.provider_max_output_invalid: Max output tokens must be a positive integer. Leave blank to use the model default.
Settings_page.provider_models_empty: No models found at this endpoint.
Settings_page.provider_models_empty_manual: No models were returned. You can enter a model ID manually.
Settings_page.provider_models_fetch_failed: Model list could not be fetched.
Settings_page.provider_output_warn_exceeds: Value exceeds the known model output limit.
Settings_page.provider_scope_global_hint_override: This repository can override specific fields locally.
Settings_page.provider_scope_hint: Configure provider access: repo-scoped configurations are isolated to this repository, while global configurations are shared across all repositories.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_default_hint: Default leaves thinking control to the model and endpoint. Off explicitly disables thinking, and is offered only when supported.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_hint_anthropic: Anthropic Extended Thinking is billed against output tokens.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_hint_azure: Azure reasoning effort uses extra completion tokens.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_hint_gemini: Gemini thinking is billed as output tokens.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_hint_ollama: Ollama think mode adds latency; tokens stay local.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_hint_openai_compat: OpenAI Compatible reasoning (like DeepSeek) consumes extra completion tokens.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_hint_openai_responses: OpenAI Responses reasoning consumes extra output tokens.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_invalid: This thinking setting is unavailable for the selected model and endpoint. Choose an available setting or use the model default.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_output_minimum: This thinking setting requires at least {minimum} output tokens. Increase the output limit in Advanced settings, or change the thinking setting.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_unsupported: Thinking controls are not verified for this model and endpoint. You can save using the model default.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_unverified: Your thinking setting has been kept. Retry the capability check, or choose the model default before saving.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_warning_agent_count: For this model, effort selects the number of agents instead of reasoning intensity.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_warning_always_on: This model always uses thinking; it cannot be switched off.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_warning_azure_profile: For an Azure deployment name, set the limits profile to the underlying model ID to resolve thinking settings.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_warning_budget_mapping: Effort levels map to the provider's thinking token budgets.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_warning_compatible_unv: These settings follow the model's published behavior. A compatible endpoint may handle them differently.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_warning_minimal_not_of: Minimal still uses thinking; it does not turn thinking off.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_warning_toggle_only: This model supports switching thinking on or off, without separate effort levels.
Settings_page.provider_thinking_warning_unknown: Some thinking behavior could not be verified. Use the model default if unsure.
